newsitem.title: UK: Next falls three pct ahead of UK Budget.
newsitem.headline: Next falls three pct ahead of UK Budget.

text.p: Shares in clothing retailer Next Plc fell more than three percent on Monday amid fears that Wednesday's budget could contain measures to dampen down booming consumer spending, analysts said.
Next shares fell 24p to 680p by 1405 GMT, making the retailer the day's biggest percentage loser in the FTSE 100.
Kingfisher Plc was another retailer in the doldrums, the stock falling 17p to 679.5p.
The miserable June weather which has seen Britain lashed by cold winds and heavy downpours were cited as another negative factor for UK retailers.

The new Labour government will unveil its first budget on Wednesday. Chancellor (finance minister) Gordon Brown is expected to include measures to slow the spending boom in order to prevent the economy from overheating.
